package com.acme.feeds

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flatMapMerge
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.toList

class FeedAggregator(private val client: FeedClient) {
    suspend fun aggregate(sources: List<String>): List<Entry> =
        sources.asFlow()
            .flatMapMerge(concurrency = 8) { src -> flow { emitAll(client.entries(src)) } }
            .toList()
}
